summary: App Review & Comment Management website with enhanced admin controls, music system, and interactive shooter game
architectural_notes: Local storage used for client-side caching with backend synchronization
Music files stored and served from backend for all users
Export functionality generates both CSV and JSON formats in single click
Browser autoplay policies handled for background music

existing_features.title: Add delete buttons for individual comments in the Admin Panel comment list management section. Each comment row should have a delete icon/button that removes that specific comment from the backend and updates the UI.
Add delete buttons for individual usernames in the Admin Live List Panel. Each username entry should have a delete icon/button that removes it from the specific app/event list.
Add a Clear All button to the Admin Panel that removes all comments, app events, and usernames from the system. This should be a prominent action button with strong confirmation.

Implement one-click download feature in Admin Panel that exports all data (comments, app events, usernames) in both CSV and JSON formats. The download should bundle all data types into separate files within a single download action.

Implement local storage caching for comment lists, app events, and usernames. Cache data locally on initial load and subsequent fetches, serving from cache for instant display while syncing with backend in the background.

Add background music system that auto-plays when the website opens (respecting browser autoplay policies with muted start if needed). Include visible play/pause and volume control buttons accessible to all users.

Add music upload and management functionality to the Admin Panel. Admins can upload audio files (MP3, WAV) which are stored in the backend and served to all users as the background music. Include options to preview, replace, and remove the current music file.

Replace the existing Interactive3DCube component with a lightweight top-down shooter mini-game using HTML5 Canvas or React Three Fiber. The game should feature player-controlled character movement (WASD or arrow keys), shooting mechanics (mouse click or spacebar), and enemy waves that spawn and move toward the player. Keep gameplay simple, engaging, and performant.
Maintain secure data handling for all new features including music uploads, game state, and admin operations. Ensure admin access code protection (5676) remains enforced for sensitive operations.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add delete buttons for individual comments and usernames in admin panel
Add Clear All button in admin panel to remove all data
Implement one-click download feature exporting all data in CSV and JSON formats
Implement local storage caching for faster list loading with backend sync
Add background music system with auto-play, play/pause and volume controls
Enable admin panel music upload and management stored live for all users
Replace 3D cube with lightweight top-down shooter mini-game
